name: opensre
description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.
one_liner: An AI agent that reads a failed CI build, figures out why it broke, and proposes a fix for a human to review, instead of an engineer losing an hour digging through logs.
buyer: An engineering manager at a growing startup where flaky CI is quietly burning developer hours every single day.
business_use_cases: A DevOps consultancy offers a 'CI reliability audit + setup' engagement that installs and tunes this agent for a client's pipeline.
A platform engineering team at a scale-up adopts it to cut CI triage time, freeing engineers to ship rather than babysit builds.
A managed-CI hosting provider offers it as a premium add-on feature for teams that don't want to self-host the agent.

money_ideas.idea: One-off setup and tuning fee for installing it into a client's CI/CD pipeline
Managed/hosted version sold as a subscription add-on for teams who don't want to self-host (the likely path for the project itself)

steal_this: This is best adopted internally to save your own team's time rather than resold - skip building a business around it unless you're already running a CI/DevOps consultancy.
